kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Aviation regulators turn to AI to help manage the nation's airspace
wire.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration launched an ambitious $875-million-dollar push to make the U.S. airspace more efficient. But critics say it won't solve bigger problems with air traffic control.

wire.title: Paramount makes concessions to salvage $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal
wire.summary: Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that endangered the media company's bid for its larger Hollywood rival, Warner Bros. Discovery.

wire.title: World leaders convene for UNGA. And, Trump says D.C. arch will be a 'military complex'
wire.summary: This week, world leaders convene for the U.N. General Assembly as war continues in Ukraine and the Gulf. And, President Trump has proposed that his arch serve as a military complex.

wire.title: Many GOP candidates still echo Trump's 2020 claims. Lots of voters want to move on
wire.summary: While many Republican candidates, even in some critical tossup races, still back President Trump's baseless claims about election integrity, some GOP voters say they are ready to move on.

wire.title: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
wire.summary: The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.

wire.title: The data center backlash is reshaping American politics — one community at a time
wire.summary: With striking speed, the widespread debate around data centers has become a fault line in American communities, cutting across political parties and forging unexpected alliances.

wire.title: What to know as world leaders converge at the United Nations this week
wire.summary: United Nations head António Guterres returns to New York for his final U.N. General Assembly as diplomacy falters over wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, and the global body faces deep divisions.

wire.title: Germany's leader stands his ground after his party loses in state elections
wire.summary: German Chancellor Freidrich Merz conceded that the night spells "disaster" for the political center, but assured the public he'd push ahead with his federal agenda of tax and welfare reforms.

wire.title: 18 suspects accused in the 2021 killing of Haiti's president being extradited to U.S.
wire.summary: Eighteen suspects who were arrested in the July 2021 killing of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse were being extradited to the U.S. on Sunday to face justice in Florida.

wire.title: How a national farm leader is dealing with record diesel prices
wire.summary: John Boyd Jr., president of the National Black Farmers Association, says soaring diesel costs are deepening a farm crisis as farmers face sharply higher fuel costs in the middle of harvest season.

wire.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
wire.summary: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

wire.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
wire.summary: Major US networks later suspended White House TV coverage of Trump as he heads to New York for the UN summit.

wire.title: Merz vows to keep coalition together for Germany's 'democratic future'
wire.summary: The chancellor has come under increasing pressure after resounding state election defeats, but says the results "go far beyond my own person"

wire.title: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
wire.summary: Dr Vincent Brown, formerly Dr Vincent Bajinya, 65, will appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Tuesday charged with seven offences.

wire.title: Millions urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan
wire.summary: The country's meteorological agency had warned of an "imminent threat to life," but this has now been downgraded in most areas.

wire.title: Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial
wire.summary: Vladimir Putin will likely use the result to claim most Russians back the so-called special military operation in Ukraine, writes the BBC's Steve Rosenberg.
